oldQuestion.prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
oldQuestion.promptZh: 請聽題目，選出最合適的回應。

options.text: The screen is beside the server rack.
options.whyZh: 設備位置無法回應時程能否延後。

options.text: Certainly; I'll move it to five thirty.
options.zh: 當然可以，我會把時間改到五點半。
options.whyZh: 問題是在請求延後重新啟動；Certainly 表示同意，並提出新的執行時間。

options.text: I demonstrated it to the client.
options.whyZh: 這只提到過去的展示，沒有回答是否可延後重啟。

oldQuestion.explanationZh: 問題是在請求延後重新啟動；Certainly 表示同意，並提出新的執行時間。
oldQuestion.evidence: Can the server restart wait until after the demonstration?

vocabulary.note: 此處為名詞，指伺服器重啟作業。

oldGroup.title: Postponing a restart
oldGroup.passage:
Can the server restart wait until after the demonstration?
A. The screen is beside the server rack. B. Certainly; I'll move it to five thirty. C. I demonstrated it to the client.
oldGroup.passageZh:
伺服器重新啟動可以等到展示結束後再進行嗎？
A. 螢幕在伺服器機櫃旁。
B. 當然可以，我會把時間改到五點半。
C. 我已向客戶展示過它。
